[{"id": "MxMhxEmuz5", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\"If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to you.\" (James 1:5)", "col": 12}}, {"id": "zQ3DR2p4Mb", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "New to Churchit, or need a refresher? This page explains the words and the moves that work everywhere in the app. Each module, such as People or Finances, has its own manual: pick one from the sidebar, or click Manual, right under Home, in that module's sidebar. On a form, the help icon at the top opens the manual for that form.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "7pXUW0lwfY", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "💬Words to Know", "col": 12}}, {"id": "KiilbeZKek", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Module: a part of the app for one area of church life, such as People, Finances or Missions.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "OAKSUwibTZ", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Dock: the narrow bar on the far left, with an icon for each module. Point at an icon to see its name. The modules that most churches use each week come first.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "urv2c8baTU", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Sidebar: the list next to the dock. It shows the pages of the module that you are in. The pages you use every day are at the top, and the others are in folders.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "tmaO6pAT1S", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Workspace: the first page of a module. Most workspaces show the work that waits for you, then a few numbers and charts.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "vYPHy_9AeK", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Apps screen: a page with a tile for each app that you can use. Click the logo at the top of the dock to open it.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "aL36j_UEhi", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Record (Frappe also says document): one saved item, such as one Person, one Fund or one Song.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "pv_j3Z2Lk1", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Form: the page where you fill in and change a record. A field with a red * must be filled in.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "X3bDjFRzxy", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- List: a page that shows the records of one kind, such as all People. Report view shows them as a table where you can filter, group and choose the columns.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "3OqzbZiqwT", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Draft, Submitted and Cancelled: some records, such as collections and expenses, are final only after you Submit them. A Draft is saved but can still change. A Submitted record cannot change unless you cancel it first. A Cancelled record stays for your history.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "xSoFaO2K_Z", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Role: what a login may see and do, such as Church Staff or Church Finance. A Role Profile is a set of roles for one job (see Logins in the People manual).", "col": 12}}, {"id": "zKI6F_fJPI", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Member portal: the app at /portal where members see their own household, sign-ups and giving.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "5jUKh5PMxd", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "🧭Getting Around", "col": 12}}, {"id": "v20603gOM6", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Logging in opens the Summary page. Its icons open each module, the same as the dock. Needs Attention counts your open assignments and the open care requests, and links to urgent prayer requests, pending alms requests and open follow-up cards. To start somewhere else, click your initials at the bottom of the dock, choose Settings, and pick a Default Workspace on the Settings tab.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "-drPqHRX4G", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Click a module in the dock to open it. In its sidebar, click a folder to open it. The lists that other records choose from, such as types and statuses, are in the Setup folder at the bottom.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "YiUEANTF7n", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- If a Frappe page, such as Email Account, opens with a dock that you do not know, click the church icon at the top of that dock to go back to Churchit.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "fu7YGjDSCJ", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Click ..., then Take the Tour, on a form to see its main fields one by one.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "enwAMJuRd3", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "🔍Search", "col": 12}}, {"id": "qhVzd2ExIP", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Press Ctrl+K (or click Search at the top of the sidebar) to jump almost anywhere:", "col": 12}}, {"id": "tEDS8MySWr", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- New Person opens a new Person form. This works for any kind of record.
- Person List opens the list of people, and Person Report opens it as a table.
- Type the name of a sidebar page, such as Families or Room Bookings, to open it.
- Type a name and \"in Person\", such as Samuel in Person, to open the People list with only the people of that name.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "j9soaZxcMp", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "", "col": 12}}, {"id": "docxnb43hC", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "To find a record by its name, type the whole name, such as Marjorie May, and press Enter, or press Ctrl+G for Global Search. This finds the people, families, groups, sermons, sermon series, functions, songs, ministries, missionaries, missionary agencies, funds, vendors, rooms, locations, assets, bulletins and beliefs that you may open.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "ESUsulkr36", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Prayer requests, care requests, counseling cases and notes about people never show here. A new or renamed record shows within 15 minutes. For a short or common name, open the list and type it in the name filter.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "T-KS7wAWGQ", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "In any field where you choose a person, you can also type a nickname, a phone number or an email address.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "PzpFyEmCvS", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "⌨️Keyboard Shortcuts", "col": 12}}, {"id": "pVkTXAp4Kl", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Press Shift+/ on any page to see all the shortcuts of that page. The most useful:", "col": 12}}, {"id": "UJZOC1nF36", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Ctrl+S saves the form.
- Ctrl+K opens Search.
- Ctrl+G opens Global Search.
- Ctrl+Shift+R reloads the page, if something did not load correctly.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "Q6a-UYZzr9", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "", "col": 12}}, {"id": "Di-lIg_bEZ", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "🔖Bible References", "col": 12}}, {"id": "iSmTI1FyUV", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Fields that hold a Bible reference, such as the Church Verse, a bulletin's Verse of the Week, a belief's Bible References, a sermon slide or a Bible Memory passage, suggest books, chapters and verses as you type. Short names work, so jn finds John. Separate several passages with a semicolon, such as Romans 3:23; Ephesians 2:8-9.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "An3-nGw1Cb", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "A reference that is not in the Bible is outlined in red with the reason, such as \"Mark 16 has 20 verses\", and the record cannot be saved until you fix it. Point at a reference to read its words in your church's default translation. A sermon slide or a Bible Memory passage that names its own translation shows that translation.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "6yjjWWOPFq", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "❓FAQ", "col": 12}}, {"id": "oyEDkJACIL", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Why does a list show fewer records than I expect?", "col": 12}}, {"id": "L7uYjEweX1", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "A list remembers the filters and the sort that you last used on it. The number next to Filters at the top of the list shows how many filters are on. Click the x next to it to clear them. A shortcut with a count, or a link from another page, also puts its filter on the list.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "aVLoIL0RbS", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Can I add my own choices to a drop-down list?", "col": 12}}, {"id": "TyinZ6aC9s", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Yes. Most lists of choices, such as types and statuses, offer Create a new ... at the end. A Church Manager can also add choices in the Setup folder of each module. To add your own fields to the Person or Family form, see Church fields in the People manual.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "FDXXDfAQtC", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Can a report be emailed to me every week?", "col": 12}}, {"id": "wvvuDiwwk5", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Yes, if your login has the Church Manager role profile. Open the report, click ..., then Setup Auto Email, then Add Auto Email Report. Choose who gets it, how often, and the filters to use. The email shows only the records that the chosen user can see in the app.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "0Aj5B7CJRH", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "How do I see a guided tour of a form?", "col": 12}}, {"id": "VyWL3kXqV9", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Open the form, click ... at the top right and choose Take the Tour. The tour shows the main fields one by one.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "AyVJMZ6L8w", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Where are Frappe's own tools?", "col": 12}}, {"id": "i_ZvCsgSsq", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Frappe's own tools are in the Framework app, which the Apps screen shows to System Managers only. The Settings sidebar lists the settings that a church needs, such as Users, Email Accounts (in the Email folder) and Print Settings (in the Printing folder). To hide a module that your church does not use, untick it in Church Features.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "PuFKGvvCwb", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "What is in the sample data, and how do I remove it?", "col": 12}}, {"id": "AbviZnF0pQ", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The Sample Data page fills the app with a made-up church, so you can try each part before you enter your own records: people and families (with a child, his grandmother and a person who may not collect him), groups, follow-up cards, giving with a pledge campaign, a function with paid sign-ups and a discount code, songs, a room with an approver, a projector on loan, sermons with a fill-in-the-blanks handout, a bulletin and a members-only page.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "3Sd4telgLG", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Each sample login, such as mary.johnson@example.com, has its email address as its password.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "odkF-fYLfj", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Only a System Manager can create or delete the sample data. Click Delete All Data on the same page to remove it. The next new record of each kind starts at number 1 again, such as PRSN-0001. Remove the sample data before your church starts to use the site.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "5Gb5ijS9o3", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Delete All Data
Delete All Data deletes every record of those kinds, also the records that you made yourself, with their history, comments and attachments.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "tQg8olzwPV", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Why is Churchit free? Is there a catch?", "col": 12}}, {"id": "J4BIyihob8", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "There is no catch. Churchit is free, apart from the cost of hosting it. Its first developer was saddened to see businesses profit from churches' need to be organized. \"Freely you have received; freely give\" (Matthew 10:8): the church can support itself through the gifts and generosity of its own members.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "pmKDuOf-mp", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "🛟Support", "col": 12}}, {"id": "1P8fQhq4bk", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "If you have a problem or an idea, report it on the Churchit GitHub page. If you have no GitHub account, or you need help, talk with us in our Matrix chat.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "M6slA0Lpc8", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "🤝Contribute", "col": 12}}, {"id": "LvXAeB67D5", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "If you can write software and want to help build Churchit, join us on GitHub. If you want to support the project with money, please do not. Instead, pray for the developers and for the churches that use Churchit.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "YLkZofXjAb", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "📢Credits", "col": 12}}, {"id": "OVC455O2Jo", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- All the contributors of this project. Thank you.
- The Frappe Framework, the open source software that Churchit is built on.
- Your IT administrator, who set Churchit up for you.
- Our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, without whom this app would not exist.", "col": 12}}]
